question: Absolute normal accuracy against DiLiGenT ground truth under finite calibration-refinement budgets.

protocol.pixel_domain: all masked pixels for endpoint; fixed 1200-pixel subset only for allocation ordering
protocol.normalization: per-light red-channel intensity normalization from calibinfo.datasets.diligent.load_object
protocol.corruption: joint Gaussian: sigma_logI=0.5 and sigma_direction=0.5 deg
protocol.estimator: 25-iteration full-mask Lambertian alternating least squares using the perturbed assumed calibration
protocol.endpoint: per-pixel angular error to DiLiGenT Normal_gt; object score is full-mask mean

map.aggregation: per-pixel mean over all 10 paired corruption seeds

scope: A fixed-protocol absolute endpoint check. It does not convert the information theorem into a universal reconstruction guarantee.
